base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038 || ' ' || d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.XCL_029 = d.XCL_034
WHERE d.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.XCL_034
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
LIMIT 1;
